single.rationale: ADP demonstrates strong fundamentals with consistent revenue growth (7-8% CAGR), exceptional cash generation ($4.9B operating cash flow), and impressive returns (66% ROE). However, the premium valuation (31x P/E, 6.1x EV/revenue) limits upside potential, while decelerating revenue growth (from 9.1% in FY23 to 7.1% in FY25) and modest pays-per-control growth (1%) suggest limited acceleration ahead despite AI investments.
